outcome.technical: A phase brief now records the set it showed beside itself, at <stateDir>/briefs/<phase>/phase.shown.<head>.json, in the shape {head, shown:[{id,commit}]}. file-return (and so submit, which forwards to it) refuses a phase return for that head that carries no --shown or a different set. The refusal names the brief's set, the record's path and the command printed under '## Your return'. A head with no record files as before; a record that cannot be read is refused rather than treated as absent. The set comparison ignores order. Shared helpers live in _filed_returns.py: BRIEFS_DIRNAME, shown_argument_of, shown_brief_path, shown_brief_text, read_shown_brief, shown_brief_refusal. In audit-lookup.py, compose_phase_brief returns (lines, head, shown); write_brief writes the record; shown_argument now goes through _fr; BRIEFS_DIRNAME aliases _fr's. audit-task.py has a new _shown_brief_refusal in _locked_file_return's phase branch. The reviewer card's filing sentence now says to run the command the brief prints under Your return, as printed, with --head and --shown, and that a return without --shown is refused; the card stays under its measure-context ceiling (6972/7000). Tests added: test_audit_task (the clause case and its ALLOW twin), test_audit_lookup (the writer-side record case), test__filed_returns pk7/pk8. test_drive_phase's fake phase reviewer now files with the --shown its brief prints, and ds8/ds8p pass --shown; the plan gate allowed that edit. Exit codes: test_audit_task 1055/1055 exit 0; sweep exit 0 (335/335 files, 16493 cases); cp1252 sweep exit 0; measure-context --gate exit 0; ruff 0; vermin 0.
outcome.descriptive: A phase return filed without the set its brief showed is now refused instead of silently repeating every fix task in the next round.

testsAdded: a phase return filed for a head whose brief showed tasks, but filed without --shown, is refused naming the missing set, and the reviewer card names the brief's printed command as the one to run (missing, a different set, the card's filing paragraph)
ALLOW: the same return filed with the brief's own `--shown` files and records that set, and a head no brief was recorded for files with no `--shown` as before
the phase brief records the set it showed beside itself, keyed by the head it was computed at, each task at the commit its section names
pk7 a brief's shown record reads back as the pairs it was written with; a head with no record reads as none, not as a problem; a record that will not parse reads as a problem, not as none
pk8 the refusal names the set the brief showed when the return carries none or another, and is None for the same pairs in another order or for a brief that showed nothing filed without `--shown`
